blurb: CH Distillery produces artisan spirits including vodka, gin, rum, and aquavit, all made from scratch using local ingredients. They operate a distillery in Chicago's Pilsen neighborhood and offer craft cocktails and sushi at their West Loop bar and restaurant. They also host private events with customizable options including craft cocktails and curated menus.
